title: feat: add Nano Banana 2.1 via OpenRouter AI Studio
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16637

- Adds paid-only `google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1` with no aliases, multiplier `1.055`, generation/editing, and up to 14 references.
- Uses OpenRouter `/api/v1/images`, pinned to `google-ai-studio` with provider fallbacks disabled. Supports 1K/2K; rejects 4K before provider execution and omits unsupported seed/reasoning controls.
- Bills reported token usage at $1.50 input / $7.50 text and reasoning / $30 image per million tokens, including OpenRouter’s 5.5% credit fee before the user multiplier. Updates the price snapshot.
- Declines Vertex fallback: live 2K/4K probes returned 1376×768 while billing larger tiers. Vercel probes omitted image-token usage.
- Validation: 114 Worker tests including the price snapshot, Gen typecheck, formatting; live generation/editing, actual Durable Object disconnect/rejoin, identical cache retrieval, one provider execution and one debit/event. All 10 aspect ratios, 2/14-reference edits, and a three-request burst passed (12 requests, 12–24s, no 429/5xx). An earlier benign prompt received a provider copyright rejection (422).

Live checks used an existing funded local OpenRouter key. The tracked encrypted configuration contains a different key that returned insufficient-credit errors; correcting that credential requires separate scoped approval before deployment.

gist.headline: Another banana in the bunch
gist.blurb: Nano Banana 2.1 joins the image-model garden for generation and editing. It can work from up to 14 reference images, which is a lot of pictures to pin above a desk.
gist.summary: Adds paid-only `google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1` via OpenRouter's Google AI Studio provider, with 1K/2K generation and editing from up to 14 reference images.
gist.impact: Developers get a distinct Nano Banana 2.1 model for image creation and reference-based edits; 4K requests are rejected before provider execution.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Nano Banana 2.1 as a cozy image-editing workbench: reference pictures clipped beside two finished pixel canvases marked 1K and 2K. Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, arranges the pictures while a friendly CRT monitor robot admires the result; lime-green code-plants and flowers bring the garden into the studio.
